blurb: Dirty Duck Boat Rental offers tritoon boat rentals, jet ski, Sea Doo, and waverunner rentals at Lake of the Ozarks. They are located on the 19 mile marker in Osage Beach, close to Party Cove and local restaurants and bars. All boats are equipped with radios, though functionality is not guaranteed due to water exposure.
extraNote: 4% use and maintenance fee added to all rental prices · 3% credit card surcharge if paying by credit card · Reservations only by phone · If hiring a driver, they are not affiliated and paid separately; renter responsible if driver no-shows · 4905 Robins Circle, Osage Beach, MO 65065, second driveway on Robins Circle, look for the DUCK
